payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must recognize that resistance is inversely proportional to the square of the diameter (R ∝ 1/d²), requiring the application of a power-law scaling factor rather than a linear one.
payload.expected_mid_student_error: The student will likely treat the relationship as linear (R ∝ 1/d) and fail to square the diameter scaling factor, leading to a predictable distractor.
notes: The idea is a classic, robust discriminator for the target difficulty level.
The use of proportional reasoning instead of absolute values effectively prevents plug-and-chug.
